mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity are potentiated by isoniazid, which can cause hepatotoxicity and impair renal function, increasing aminoglycoside accumulation.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, BUN) and auditory function closely; consider therapeutic drug monitoring of amikacin; ensure adequate hydration and assess for ototoxic/vestibular symptoms.
